en.start_text: Hello! I'm a post bot. I can post your messages to your group | channel. Click /help for more information and setup guide.
en.help_text: If you want to use me, invite me to your group | channel with admin rights. After that click /options and follow guide to set your group | channel.
en.set_group:
1. Invite me to your group | channel with admin rights.
2. Forward a message from your group | channel to this chat.
en.set_group_success: Success! Now you can post messages!
en.set_group_failed: It's seems you're not invite me to this group | channel or it's not a message from it. Please, try again.
en.group_id_null: You doesn't set a group | channel. Click /options and follow guide to set your group | channel.
en.ticket_unavailable: This ticket is unavailable cause timeout. Send your post again.
en.not_admin_rights: I'm not have rights to post in that group | channel. Invite me to this group | channel before.
